name: hr_payroll_hardening
summary: Effective-dated rules, statutory config, maker-checker approval, freeze, idempotent payment, adjustments, reconciliation
description: Production guardrails on top of hr_payroll without migrating its tables: versioned / effective-dated salary rules, jurisdiction-and-date-scoped statutory (tax/pension) configuration, a maker-checker approval that freezes an approved payslip run so payslips cannot be silently edited, idempotent payment (no double disbursement), traceable adjustment/reversal entries instead of in-place edits, a bank payment-file batch, payslip delivery to the employee and run reconciliation with an expected-vs-paid audit. Extends the hr anchor and hr_payroll; navigated under the single HR app.
author: Nexa
